power_recertification_note: The four blockers do not touch the certified effect, estimator, model, or geometry. Blocker A's secret tie-break is dead code (best-single = offset 0 in 200/200 independent replicates; 0 step-1 ties), so removing/replacing it provably cannot change any selection. B/C/D are protocol-hardening, not design changes.

blockers.summary: best-single tie-break step (2) 'max mean frozen continuous margin (tau - |eff|)' reads eff = actual_bias + offset, and actual_bias is in the secret_denylist. An oracle/secret quantity must not participate in the state-agnostic best-single baseline.
blockers.independent_evidence: best_single returns offset 0.0 in 200/200 replicates; step-1 (max mean success) is a tie in 0/200 -> the secret margin is never consulted (dead code).
blockers.minimal_fix: Replace step (2) with an OBSERVABLE continuous tie-break computed on train+val only (e.g. min mean task_outcome_error, or min mean |final_joint_position - target|, or min mean skill_elapsed_time), OR delete step (2) and go step1 -> min |offset| -> fixed numeric order. Remove the secret margin from the power code's best_single too.
blockers.power_recert_reason: Provably no-change: step-1 uniquely selects offset 0 in every replicate, so the tie-break never decides. Prove from the saved best-single selection logs / the 200/200 replicate check, not a re-run.

blockers.summary: Only model_seeds {1103,2207,3301,4409,5519} are frozen. master_seed (and the residual/block-order/session-order/nominal-order/candidate-order/bootstrap seeds derived from it) have NO frozen integer value and NO derivation rule from the commit/config hash. The manifest spec says Claude A will 'Fix master_seed' at construction time -> a post-hoc randomization choice, which the preregistration forbids.
blockers.minimal_fix: Freeze an exact integer master_seed and bootstrap_seed in confirmatory_v4_config.json (all sub-seeds already derive deterministically from master_seed), OR freeze an unambiguous derivation rule such as master_seed = int(sha256(config_hash).hexdigest()[:8], 16). The bootstrap_seed must be frozen before test is unsealed.

blockers.summary: The seal/unseal protocol keeps an either/or: STEP 2 = 'test is either (a) not yet generated, or (b) generated into a sealed store'. A preregistration must freeze exactly ONE executable scheme so there is no run-time discretion over when/how the test outcomes come into existence.
blockers.minimal_fix: Choose ONE. Recommended Scheme 2 (generate test only after model + analysis hashes are frozen), since it needs no encryption/access-control machinery: STEP 2 becomes 'test manifest is frozen (hashed) now; test TRIALS are generated only after STEP 6, from that frozen manifest, with no test seed/manifest re-selection'. Define exactly who may read secret/test, prove the feature cache holds no test outcome, and state that any accidental early unseal makes the experiment INVALID.

blockers.summary: A model-training exception is labelled 'TECHNICAL-INVALID event (§17)', conflating an analysis-stage model-fit failure with the 300 runtime-trial technical-invalid budget (max 15). There is no rule that ALL 5 model seeds must converge and freeze a hash, and the seed-stability gate '>=4/5 seeds >=0.15' could silently PASS with a missing (failed) seed - effectively dropping a seed.
blockers.minimal_fix: Separate model-training-failure handling from the 300-trial technical-invalid count. Freeze: all 5 model seeds MUST converge and have a frozen state_dict hash; a training exception triggers a deterministic same-seed retry (fixed max retries), no seed replacement, and if any of the 5 seeds still fails the PRIMARY analysis is INVALID (not a 4/5 pass). State that the seed-gate denominator is fixed at 5 and a missing seed is a failed seed, never an excluded one.

minor_issues.summary: band_edge_exit_verdict_v1.json still reads MODIFY_RESIDUAL_OR_DESIGN and residual_induces_block_label_variation=false; that analysis was for the OLD +-0.03 geometry. v4's +-0.035 resolves it. Independently verified from the 306 data: state-aware region |eff| in [0,0.015] -> success 1.0 (deterministic); best-single offset-0 at +-0.035 (|eff| in [0.025,0.045]) -> success 0.53 (MIXED); offsets +-0.030/0.035/0.040 are mixed across the 18 blocks (residual-driven). Non-degenerate at the real operating point.
minor_issues.recommendation: Add an explicit +-0.035 operating-point residual-label-variation confirmation from the 306 data and supersede/relabel the stale exit verdict so the evidence chain is unambiguous. (Evidence already exists in the 306 sec-8.1 table; this is documentation, not new data.)

minor_issues.summary: The power tau-sensitivity spans only {0.0342, 0.03425, 0.0343} (logistic neighbourhood), but the edge-location uncertainty is [isotonic 0.0325, logistic 0.03425]. The untested lower tau makes the effect LARGER (best-single fails harder), so power is conservative, not threatened.
minor_issues.recommendation: For completeness report power at tau = 0.0325 (isotonic crossing) too; expected to pass with a larger gain.

minor_issues.summary: features.probe_vector uses h.get(field, 0.0); a missing required probe field becomes 0.0 rather than erroring.
minor_issues.recommendation: Have the generator assert all 8 probe-allowlist fields are present (schema-completeness is already a technical-invalid condition, so largely covered); add a guard test.

minor_issues.summary: DeepSets.__init__ defaults (max_epochs=300, patience=30) differ from the frozen values (200/25). Both power and confirmatory pass explicit values, so there is no practical mismatch.
minor_issues.recommendation: Align the __init__ defaults to the frozen values to avoid future confusion (cosmetic).

Recomputed.
